**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 13 satisfies the LICENSE rule at the preferred position:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — §13.1 grants access rights directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with no notice precondition; §13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates and permits contractors to support the material.
- **Not revocable at will** — §13.2 is expressly "perpetual, irrevocable" for paid-up/embedded material, and §13.3 limits revocation or suspension of any licence to a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Successor transfer** — §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor, tied to §24.1, which allows assignment without Vendor consent in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.

§13.4's use restrictions (no reverse engineering, no security bypass) are ordinary and carved back for legally permitted acts and authorized security testing, so they do not narrow the grant below the fallback.
